verdict.rationale: Cekura documents its own rule-based conditional actions: Structured Tests evaluators adapt their behavior when specific conversation conditions occur. Cron jobs also alert you when runs fail. Both are narrow, though: conditional actions only apply inside simulated test conversations, and failure alerting is tied to scheduled runs rather than to user-defined event rules. Missing for 10: general user-defined event→action rules on platform events (e.g. production call or metric events), configurable action types, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Create dynamic, rule-based evaluators that respond to specific conversation conditions
Structured Tests evaluators can adapt their behavior based on what the agent says during the conversation.
Cron jobs run automated calls on a schedule to check the status of your agent and alert you if things fail.
